## Check the log

Open the AppDaemon add-on in Home Assistant and select **Log**, or run the command the deploy script prints:

```sh
ssh root@homeassistant.local ha addons logs a0d7b954_appdaemon
```

Each app logs one line when it loads, with its light, levels, start triggers and test event. For example:

```
bedroom_sunrise loaded: light.bedroom_lamp, -6 to 0, start (Daily(daily='05:45:00'),), test event bedroom_sunrise_start
```

A settings mistake shows up here as a validation error naming the bad setting.

## Fire a test event

Each app listens for the event `<app name>_start`. In Home Assistant, go to **Developer Tools > Events**, enter the event type, for example `bedroom_sunrise_start`, and select **Fire event**.

This runs the same check as the app's start trigger. During the fade window the light changes. Outside it the log says `<app name>: outside fade, nothing to do`, which still confirms the app is running.
